problem: PR-003 handoff and task packets had no machine-checkable shape, so an independent reviewer could not distinguish a claim from an executed command, a referenced artifact from a missing one, or a current dependency binding from a stale one without reading a chat transcript.
resulting_behavior: Two JSON Schema documents (task.schema.json, handoff.schema.json) define the task/dispatch and handoff/receipt contracts, and a bounded local checker demonstrates that a valid packet is accepted while a claimed pass without a command result, a missing artifact reference, and a stale dependency SHA are each rejected.

commits.subject: Add the task and receipt schemas

commands.expected: exit 0 with ok=true: valid fixture accepted and all three rejection fixtures rejected for the declared reason
commands.actual: exit 0 with ok=true for the committed fixture set
commands.result: Schema-contract check accepted handoff.valid.json and rejected reject-claimed-pass-without-command, reject-missing-artifact and reject-stale-dependency-sha for their declared reasons.

acceptance_results.result: The task and handoff/receipt schemas compile under Ajv strict, the valid fixture is accepted, and each of the three required rejection fixtures is rejected for its declared reason.

unresolved_claims.detail: The one-shot slice does not stage or commit, so head_sha and commits[].sha are intentionally null until the controller performs the ordinary Git commit in a fresh worktree-bootstrap launch.
unresolved_claims.next_action: Controller commits the allowlisted diff and records the resulting head SHA in the PR-003 handoff.

unresolved_claims.detail: Producer checks are not independent verification; the schema contract has not been replayed by Astra.
unresolved_claims.next_action: Astra independently inspects the diff and replays the decisive check on the exact reviewed head.

risks.detail: PR-001.json and PR-002.json predate this schema and use narrative-only acceptance results; the schema is intentionally not claimed to validate them.
risks.next_action: Keep historical packets unchanged; apply the contract to PR-003 onward.

next_consumer: PR-003 C-003-2 (handoff packet validation) and C-003-3 (PR guidance and test discovery), then Astra independent review.
next_action: Controller inspects the allowlisted diff, verifies the writer lock, commits C-003-1, and dispatches C-003-2 in this worktree.

limitations: Fixture-level contract check only; an implementer statement is not independent verification.
No commit/head SHA exists in a one-shot slice, so reviewed_head_sha is null.
